files.name: StoneByHand.java

help: Mine visible stone within reach (or dig down) after collect timed out; arg stone:N
lesson: Collect stone timeouts come from long routes to remembered stone or long stair digs; stone is almost always within arm's reach or one block down, so mining in place should finish in seconds.
summary: stone_by_hand: after a collect TIMEOUT when collect stone is next, mine visible stone in reach (or dig straight down) instead of the long walk/stair route
